hints.text: Calculate the running total of match scores partitioned by gender and ordered chronologically by day.

hints.title: Sum Window Frame Specification

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT gender, day, 
       SUM(score_points) OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY day) AS total_points
FROM Scores
ORDER BY gender, day;
```

complexity.notes: Sorting by gender and day allows rolling prefix accumulation in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated self-joins comparing days quadratic in row count cause major performance slowdowns.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Window summation accumulates prefix totals without auxiliary table allocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of SUM() OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...).

solutions.approach: Cumulative Window Sum Partitioned by Gender

solutions.code:
SELECT gender, day, 
       SUM(score_points) OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY day) AS total_points
FROM Scores
ORDER BY gender, day;

import pandas as pd

def running_total_for_different_genders(scores: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    scores = scores.sort_values(by=['gender', 'day'])
    scores['total_points'] = scores.groupby('gender')['score_points'].cumsum()
    return scores[['gender', 'day', 'total_points']]
